latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the ntriq-world-bank-economic-indicators skill.
- Free API providing access to 1,500+ World Bank development and economic indicators across 217 economies.
- Query GDP, inflation, poverty, trade, and more, with no subscription required.
- Supports ISO country codes, custom indicator arrays, and optional date ranges.
- Pay-per-use access via x402 endpoint, with micropayments in USDC (Base mainnet).
